description: Machine-readable requirements for confidential-guest admission. One exact technology per qualification; nothing here provisions, spends, or converts.

permissions.notes: Checks run unprivileged first; privileged steps need their own authorization and a disposable guest.

owned_region_mechanism.failed_restore: retain allocation and module reference until disposable guest reboot
owned_region_mechanism.ledger_transport: bounded read-only sysfs parameter; no kernel log collection
owned_region_mechanism.ordinary_transport: per-CPU bpftrace count(), zero-retention control, retained/revert and repeated normal unload
owned_region_mechanism.live_journal_projection_integration: not implemented; separate admitted adapter required

forbidden: full boot logs or command lines in artifacts
